mapper.select: SELECT e.transfer_id, t.transfer_type, e.entry_type, e.amount, e.balance_after, t.memo, e.created_at FROM wallet_ledger_entries e JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = e.transfer_id WHERE e.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
